finding: The older FDX3 matrix promotion label says 'bounded headless TTS producer cancellation + packet composition only', but the newer execution binding correctly distinguishes internal producer cancellation from fail-closed sink-delivery cancellation. The first owner-VPS system run may pass the packet/sink cancellation invariant even when the selected existing TTS producer cannot be interrupted internally. These are separate evidence scopes and must not be collapsed.

producer_generation_cancel_credit.promote_only_if: The exact engine/runtime exposes and executes an internal close/cancel/stop boundary and the trace proves no later producer chunks are generated or emitted after the admitted producer-cancel boundary, except explicitly characterized in-flight work.

sink_delivery_cancel_credit.promote_if: After the admitted causal cancel boundary, zero new chunks/frames for the interrupted VoiceOutputPacket are accepted by the exact headless/virtual sink, with any preaccepted buffered frames separately measured.

packet_commit_fence_credit.promote_if: Interrupted VoiceOutputPacket terminalizes commit_eligible=false and cannot create durable heard/result/tool ownership, independent of whether discarded producer work continues transiently.

acceptance.FDX3_MINIMUM_SYSTEM_PASS: Real local TTS produces at least one chunk admitted to the sink for the old packet; barge-in is causally admitted; no later chunk is sink-admitted for that packet; old packet remains non-commit-eligible; replacement output completes. producer_cancel_capability may be false.
acceptance.FDX3_PRODUCER_CANCEL_PASS: FDX3_MINIMUM_SYSTEM_PASS plus exact internal producer cancellation is actually executed and observed.
acceptance.FDX3_PHYSICAL_SILENCE_PASS: Not representable by the headless/file/null sink alone and remains S4/physical unless a separately admitted physical target executes it.
